svg.text: SQL · S05 · Scalar UDF in WHERE kills; inline TVF can expand
Scalar in a filter is the expensive one.
Per-row UDF blocks parallelism. Inline TVF expands.
Find it in the predicate, inline or persist, re-measure.
dbo.Trim(Name) in WHERE is not sargable.

text.tspan: Easy to write, expensive to run
Inline TVF expands like a view
Rewrite if the plan shows a UDF

svg.text: RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN — optimizer can expand it.
Inline TVF, not a per-row scalar in WHERE.
LINQ on IQueryable stays sargable. AsEnumerable does not.

text.tspan: Keep scalars out of hot predicates
Persist a normalized column if you filter it
